channels.name: NTV HD
channels.description:
Nippon Television (NTV) is one of Japan's major commercial broadcasters, based in Tokyo and broadcasting terrestrially to the Kanto region. Affiliated with the Yomiuri Shimbun group, it was the first commercial television station in Japan, going on air in 1953, and it heads the nationwide NNN/NNS network.

NTV's schedule mixes popular variety and comedy shows, primetime dramas, anime, documentaries and news programmes. It is also a major name in sports broadcasting, with coverage that has included professional baseball, football and the much-loved New Year university relay race tradition.

If you want a taste of mainstream Japanese television, NTV is a great place to start. Fans of lively variety shows, character-driven dramas and big sporting events will find plenty to enjoy, and it is a handy way to keep up with what people across Japan are watching and talking about.

channels.name: TBS HD
channels.description:
TBS Television (Tokyo Broadcasting System) is a leading commercial broadcaster headquartered in Akasaka, Tokyo, broadcasting terrestrially across the Kanto region. Its roots go back to the 1950s, and it is the key station of the JNN news network, whose programmes are seen by viewers all over Japan.

TBS is especially well known for its high-quality television dramas, many of which become talking points across the country. Viewers can also expect variety and talk shows, music programmes, documentaries, news and sports coverage, including major international events.

TBS is a natural choice for drama lovers and anyone who enjoys polished, story-driven entertainment. Whether you want the latest weekly series, a light-hearted variety show or the evening news, it offers a well-rounded window into Japanese television culture.

channels.name: Fuji TV HD
channels.description:
Fuji Television is a major Tokyo-based commercial broadcaster serving the Kanto region terrestrially, with its distinctive headquarters building in Odaiba. Launched in 1959, it is the core station of the FNN news network and the FNS entertainment network, and part of Fuji Media Holdings.

Fuji TV has long been associated with trend-setting dramas, comedy and variety programmes, as well as anime and large-scale entertainment specials. Its schedule also includes news, morning information shows, documentaries and sports coverage across a range of events.

Fuji TV suits viewers who enjoy pop-culture-driven entertainment, stylish dramas and big-name variety shows. It is a fun channel to drop into when you want something upbeat, and a great way to stay connected with the latest trends in Japan.

channels.name: TV Asahi HD
channels.description:
TV Asahi is a major commercial broadcaster headquartered in Roppongi, Tokyo, broadcasting terrestrially to the Kanto region. Affiliated with the Asahi Shimbun, it began in 1959 under the name NET before becoming TV Asahi, and it serves as the key station of the ANN news network.

TV Asahi is known for long-running detective and crime dramas, popular anime aimed at children and families, variety shows and in-depth news programmes. It also broadcasts a variety of sports, with coverage that has included football, figure skating and other major events.

Mystery fans, families and news watchers will all find something to like on TV Asahi. It is a dependable channel for an evening of drama, a family anime session or catching up on current affairs in Japan.

channels.name: TV Tokyo HD
channels.description:
TV Tokyo is a Tokyo-based commercial broadcaster serving the Kanto region terrestrially. Affiliated with the Nikkei business newspaper group, it is the key station of the TXN network and has built a reputation for a distinctive, sometimes refreshingly unconventional style.

TV Tokyo is famous for its large line-up of anime, as well as economic and business news, quirky documentary-style variety shows and food and travel programmes. It also airs dramas, late-night series and selected sports.

Anime fans and anyone curious about the offbeat side of Japanese TV will enjoy TV Tokyo. It is also a good pick for viewers interested in business and the economy, offering a different flavour from the other major networks.

channels.name: TOKYO MX1 HD
channels.description:
TOKYO MX is Tokyo Metropolitan Television, an independent terrestrial station that has served the Tokyo area since 1995. Not tied to any of the big national networks, it has the freedom to build its own schedule, and MX1 is its main channel.

TOKYO MX is especially well known among anime fans, with many late-night anime series appearing on its schedule each season. It also offers local news and information about Tokyo, talk and variety shows, and programmes about city life and culture.

If you follow the latest anime season, TOKYO MX1 is a channel worth keeping close. It is also a pleasant way to get a feel for everyday life in Tokyo through its local news and lifestyle programming.

channels.name: MBS
channels.description:
MBS (Mainichi Broadcasting System) is a major commercial broadcaster based in Osaka, broadcasting terrestrially to the Kansai region. It is a core affiliate of the TBS-led JNN network and has a long history in both radio and television in western Japan.

MBS carries popular network dramas and variety shows alongside its own Kansai-produced programmes, including comedy, talk and information shows with a strong local flavour. It also produces anime, news and sports coverage, and is associated with the spring national high school baseball tournament.

MBS is perfect for viewers who enjoy the energy and humour of Kansai television. It combines nationally popular shows with real local character, making it a great way to experience the Osaka style of entertainment.

channels.name: ABC
channels.description:
ABC (Asahi Broadcasting Corporation) is a commercial broadcaster based in Osaka, serving the Kansai region terrestrially. It is a key affiliate of the TV Asahi-led ANN network and one of the leading broadcasters in western Japan.

ABC offers network dramas, anime and variety programmes along with its own Kansai-made comedy, talk and information shows. It is closely associated with the summer national high school baseball tournament at Koshien, and also produces news and other sports coverage.

Fans of Kansai comedy, high school baseball and family entertainment will feel at home with ABC. It is an enjoyable channel for discovering the lively broadcasting culture of Osaka.

channels.name: Kansai TV
channels.description:
Kansai Television (Kansai TV) is an Osaka-based commercial broadcaster serving the Kansai region terrestrially. It is a major affiliate of the Fuji TV-led FNN/FNS network and contributes a number of its own programmes to the national schedule.

Viewers can expect a mix of Fuji network dramas and variety shows together with Kansai TV's own productions, including comedy, talk shows, local news and information programmes. Its line-up also features sports and occasional large-scale entertainment specials.

Kansai TV is a great choice for those who like Fuji-style entertainment with a local Osaka twist. It is ideal for relaxed evenings of variety, drama and plenty of laughter.

channels.name: ytv
channels.description:
ytv (Yomiuri Telecasting Corporation) is an Osaka-based commercial broadcaster serving the Kansai region terrestrially. It is a leading affiliate of the Nippon TV-led NNN/NNS network and has a long history of producing programmes for national audiences.

ytv broadcasts Nippon TV network dramas, variety and news, alongside its own Kansai-produced comedy, talk and information shows. It is also known for producing popular anime and for its local news and sports coverage.

ytv is a good fit for viewers who enjoy Kansai humour, well-loved anime and mainstream network entertainment. It is an easy channel to settle into for both light-hearted shows and local news.

channels.name: TV Osaka
channels.description:
TV Osaka is an Osaka-based commercial broadcaster serving the Kansai region terrestrially. It is an affiliate of the TV Tokyo-led TXN network and, like its partner station, is linked to the Nikkei business newspaper group.

TV Osaka carries much of TV Tokyo's line-up, including anime, economic news, travel and food programmes and distinctive variety shows. It also produces its own local programmes focused on Osaka and the wider Kansai area.

If you enjoy TV Tokyo-style programming, anime or business-oriented content, TV Osaka is well worth a look. It also gives a friendly local perspective on everyday life in Kansai.

channels.name: SUN TV
channels.description:
SUN TV (Sun Television) is an independent terrestrial broadcaster based in Kobe, serving Hyogo Prefecture and parts of the surrounding Kansai area. As an independent station, it builds its own schedule rather than relaying one of the national networks.

SUN TV is particularly well known for its extensive coverage of Hanshin Tigers professional baseball. The rest of its schedule includes local news and information, regional variety shows, anime, horse racing and programmes about the Kobe and Hyogo area.

Hanshin Tigers fans will find SUN TV essential viewing during the baseball season. It is also a charming way to get to know the local culture and everyday life of Kobe and Hyogo.

channels.name: BS NTV
channels.description:
BS NTV (BS Nittele) is the BS satellite channel of the Nippon Television group, available nationwide across Japan. It launched with the start of BS digital broadcasting and complements its terrestrial parent with its own distinct line-up.

BS NTV airs a range of programmes including travel and culture documentaries, dramas, music shows, information programmes and sports, with professional baseball featuring prominently in season. It also carries news and lifestyle content suited to relaxed viewing.

BS NTV is a pleasant choice for viewers who enjoy calm, informative programming and a good game of baseball. It is a nice channel to have on for travel, history and lifestyle shows at a gentler pace.

channels.name: BS Asahi
channels.description:
BS Asahi is the BS satellite channel of the TV Asahi group, broadcasting nationwide across Japan. It began with the launch of BS digital broadcasting and offers a schedule distinct from its terrestrial sister station.

BS Asahi features travel and nature documentaries, music programmes, dramas including popular detective series, and in-depth news and discussion shows. It also carries culture, lifestyle and sports programmes.

Viewers who appreciate unhurried travel shows, nostalgic music and thoughtful documentaries will enjoy BS Asahi. It is well suited to relaxed viewing and to discovering new corners of Japan and the world.

channels.name: BS TBS
channels.description:
BS-TBS is the BS satellite channel of the TBS group, broadcasting nationwide across Japan. It started with the beginning of BS digital broadcasting and offers its own schedule alongside selected content from TBS.

BS-TBS is known for history and culture documentaries, travel programmes, period and contemporary dramas, and news analysis shows. Its line-up also includes music, entertainment and sports programming.

BS-TBS is a great channel for history buffs, documentary lovers and fans of classic drama. It offers rewarding, thoughtful viewing whenever you want something with a little more depth.

channels.name: BS TV Tokyo
channels.description:
BS TV Tokyo is the BS satellite channel of the TV Tokyo group, available nationwide across Japan. It began with BS digital broadcasting and shares much of the character of its terrestrial parent, including a strong focus on business and lifestyle content.

BS TV Tokyo offers economic and business news, travel and food programmes, documentaries, dramas and anime. It also carries hobby and leisure shows, such as fishing and outdoor programmes, along with selected sports.

BS TV Tokyo suits viewers who want a mix of practical information and easy-going entertainment. Fans of business news, travel and food shows will find plenty to enjoy at any time of day.

channels.name: BS Fuji
channels.description:
BS Fuji is the BS satellite channel of the Fuji Media Holdings group, broadcasting nationwide across Japan. It launched with the start of BS digital broadcasting and offers a schedule distinct from terrestrial Fuji TV.

BS Fuji's line-up includes news and political discussion programmes, travel and culture shows, dramas, music and entertainment. It also features documentaries, lifestyle content and a range of sports.

BS Fuji is a good pick for viewers who like current affairs discussion as well as relaxed lifestyle and travel shows. It offers a balanced mix for both informative and casual viewing.

channels.name: BS 10 Star Channel
channels.description:
BS10 Star Channel is the BS satellite home of Star Channel, one of Japan's longest-established premium movie channels. It is dedicated to films and aimed at cinema lovers across Japan.

The channel focuses on movies, especially Hollywood and international films, ranging from recent releases and blockbusters to well-loved classics. Films are typically offered with Japanese subtitles or dubbing, and the line-up is complemented by film-related programmes and international drama series.

Movie lovers will feel right at home with BS10 Star Channel. It is ideal for a film night, whether you are in the mood for action, romance, drama or a timeless classic.

channels.name: Green Channel
channels.description:
Green Channel is a specialist channel dedicated to Japanese horse racing, closely associated with the Japan Racing Association (JRA). It is available via satellite and cable and is a long-standing favourite among racing fans in Japan.

Green Channel covers JRA races, including the big graded races, along with race previews, paddock coverage, results and expert analysis. It also features programmes about horses, jockeys, training and racing culture.

If you follow Japanese horse racing, Green Channel is the place to be. Whether you are a seasoned fan or simply enjoy the excitement of race day, it brings you close to the action and the stories behind it.

channels.name: Animax
channels.description:
Animax is a dedicated anime channel in Japan, launched in 1998 and associated with the Sony group. It is available via CS satellite and cable and has become a familiar name for anime fans across the country.

Animax broadcasts a wide variety of Japanese anime, from recent series to classic favourites, covering genres such as action, comedy, romance, sports and fantasy. It also features anime-related specials and programmes.

Animax is perfect for anime fans of all ages, whether you want to catch up on a recent series or revisit an old favourite. It is an easy channel to explore when you simply want great animation.

channels.name: Nihon Eiga Senmon
channels.description:
Nihon Eiga Senmon Channel (Japanese Movie Channel) is a specialist channel devoted to Japanese cinema. It is available via CS satellite and cable and is popular with film enthusiasts.

The channel shows Japanese films from many eras, from classic masterpieces to more recent titles, across genres including drama, comedy, crime, period films and romance. It also features restored films and programmes about the people and history behind Japanese cinema.

Nihon Eiga Senmon is a treat for anyone who wants to explore the rich history of Japanese film. It is ideal for discovering classics you may have missed and enjoying a relaxed evening of cinema.

channels.name: Sky A
channels.description:
Sky A is a sports channel from the group of Osaka-based Asahi Broadcasting (ABC), available via CS satellite and cable. Its programming has a strong connection to sports in western Japan.

Sky A is especially known for its coverage of high school baseball, alongside professional baseball and a range of other sports such as golf, motorsports and combat sports. It also airs sports news, highlights and related programmes.

Sky A is a great channel for baseball fans, especially those who love the passion and drama of high school baseball. Sports enthusiasts of all kinds will find plenty of action to follow.

channels.name: Fishing Vision
channels.description:
Fishing Vision is a specialist channel dedicated to fishing, available via CS satellite and cable in Japan. It is aimed at anglers and anyone who enjoys the outdoors.

The channel covers many styles of fishing, including sea, river, lake and lure fishing, with programmes on techniques, tackle, fishing spots and tournaments. It also features outdoor travel and nature content.

Whether you are an experienced angler or just enjoy calm scenes by the water, Fishing Vision is a relaxing channel to watch. It is also a great source of tips and inspiration for your next fishing trip.

channels.name: Disney Channel
channels.description:
Disney Channel Japan is the Japanese version of the Walt Disney Company's family entertainment channel. It is available via satellite and cable and brings Disney's world of stories to audiences in Japan.

Disney Channel features animated series, live-action shows and movies for children and families, including well-known Disney characters and franchises. Programmes are generally presented in Japanese, making them easy for young viewers to follow.

Disney Channel is a lovely choice for family viewing and for kids who love Disney characters. It is a cheerful channel to put on when everyone wants something fun and familiar.

channels.name: JCOM BS
channels.description:
J:COM BS is a free-to-air BS satellite channel operated by J:COM, one of Japan's largest cable television and telecommunications providers. It is available nationwide to anyone with BS reception.

J:COM BS offers a varied schedule including documentaries, travel and regional programmes, dramas, lifestyle shows and entertainment. Much of its content highlights local areas, culture and everyday life across Japan.

J:COM BS is a pleasant channel for easy-going viewing and for discovering regional Japan. It suits viewers who enjoy travel, culture and relaxed entertainment.

channels.name: Jidaigeki Senmon
channels.description:
Jidaigeki Senmon Channel is a specialist channel dedicated to Japanese period drama, known as jidaigeki. It is available via CS satellite and cable and has a loyal following among fans of historical storytelling.

The channel broadcasts classic and newer period dramas and films set in Japan's past, featuring samurai, swordfights, Edo-era tales and famous historical figures. It also includes related documentaries and specials about the genre.

If you love samurai tales and historical drama, Jidaigeki Senmon Channel is a must. It is a wonderful way to enjoy one of Japan's most classic storytelling traditions.

channels.name: Toei Channel
channels.description:
Toei Channel is a specialist channel run by the Toei group, one of Japan's best-known film and television studios. It is available via CS satellite and cable.

Toei Channel showcases films and series from the Toei library, including period films, crime and yakuza films, dramas and tokusatsu hero series. It also offers specials related to Toei productions and the people who made them.

Toei Channel is ideal for fans of classic Japanese cinema, hero shows and gritty genre films. It is a great channel for exploring the history of one of Japan's legendary studios.

channels.name: Eisei Gekijo
channels.description:
Eisei Gekijo is a specialist channel from Shochiku, the long-established Japanese film and theatre company. It is available via CS satellite and cable.

The channel offers Japanese films from the Shochiku library, period dramas and classic television series, along with stage performances including kabuki. It also presents programmes exploring traditional performing arts and the stars who bring them to life.

Eisei Gekijo is a rewarding channel for lovers of Japanese film, theatre and traditional culture. It is perfect for anyone curious about kabuki or eager to revisit classic cinema.

channels.name: Family Gekijyo
channels.description:
Family Gekijo is a specialist entertainment channel in Japan, available via CS satellite and cable. It focuses on Japanese dramas and entertainment for a broad audience.

The channel broadcasts Japanese dramas, including well-loved series from past years, along with music, variety and entertainment programmes. It also features specials and live entertainment content.

Family Gekijo is a good choice for viewers who enjoy revisiting favourite Japanese dramas and entertainment. It is a comfortable, familiar channel for relaxed viewing at home.

channels.name: Movie Plus
channels.description:
Movie Plus is a movie channel in Japan available via CS satellite and cable. It focuses on international films and is aimed at viewers who enjoy a good night of cinema.

Movie Plus shows a range of foreign films, especially Hollywood titles, covering action, suspense, comedy, drama and more. It also carries international drama series and movie-related programmes.

Movie Plus is great for movie fans who want a steady stream of entertaining films. It is perfect when you want to sit back and enjoy a big-screen story at home.

channels.name: Home Drama Channel
channels.description:
Home Drama Channel is a specialist drama channel available via CS satellite and cable in Japan. It is focused on drama series for viewers who love serialised storytelling.

The channel broadcasts Japanese dramas, including classic and memorable series, along with Korean dramas. Its line-up covers family stories, romance, mystery and other popular genres.

Home Drama Channel is a comfortable choice for drama fans who enjoy settling in with a good series. It is ideal for both nostalgic favourites and discovering something new.

channels.name: Tabi Channel
channels.description:
Tabi Channel is a travel-focused channel in Japan, available via CS satellite and cable. It is dedicated to showing destinations in Japan and around the world.

Tabi Channel features travel documentaries and programmes about scenery, culture, food, hot springs, railways and local traditions. It covers both domestic destinations and overseas journeys.

Tabi Channel is perfect for armchair travellers and anyone planning their next getaway. It is a calming, inspiring channel to watch whenever you want to see more of the world.

channels.name: Fuji TV Next
channels.description:
Fuji TV Next is a CS satellite channel operated by Fuji Television, available via satellite and cable in Japan. It is best known for live coverage of sports and events.

Fuji TV Next focuses on live sports, including professional baseball and other competitions, as well as live music and entertainment events. It also carries related specials and highlights programmes.

Fuji TV Next is a great pick for viewers who love live action, whether on the field or on stage. Sports fans and music lovers alike will find plenty to look forward to.

channels.name: GAORA Sports
channels.description:
GAORA Sports is a Kansai-based sports channel available via CS satellite and cable in Japan. It has a strong focus on sports that are popular in western Japan.

GAORA is particularly known for its coverage of the Hanshin Tigers professional baseball team. It also broadcasts other sports such as basketball, football, motorsports and wrestling, along with sports news and features.

GAORA Sports is an excellent channel for Tigers fans and anyone who loves following Japanese sports. It is a lively choice for game days and catching up on the action.

channels.name: Golf Network
channels.description:
Golf Network is Japan's dedicated golf channel, available via CS satellite and cable. It is aimed at golf players and fans throughout the country.

The channel covers professional golf tournaments from Japan and overseas, along with lesson programmes, course guides, equipment features and golf news. It offers content for both spectators and players hoping to improve their game.

Golf Network is a must for golfers and golf fans alike. Whether you want to follow a tournament or pick up tips for your next round, it has plenty to offer.

channels.name: Nittele G+
channels.description:
Nittele G+ is Nippon Television's sports channel, available via CS satellite and cable in Japan. It is closely associated with the Yomiuri Giants professional baseball team.

Nittele G+ is known for its coverage of Yomiuri Giants baseball games and related programmes. It also airs other sports such as football and wrestling, along with sports news and documentaries.

Giants fans will find Nittele G+ an essential channel during the baseball season. It is also a solid pick for sports fans who want in-depth coverage and highlights.

channels.name: Mondo TV
channels.description:
Mondo TV is a specialist channel in Japan available via CS satellite and cable. It focuses on mind sports and table games that are deeply rooted in Japanese culture.

Mondo TV is particularly known for mahjong, along with shogi, go and other games. Its programmes include matches and tournaments, expert commentary and instructional content for players of different levels.

Mondo TV is perfect for anyone who loves strategy and table games. Whether you are a seasoned player or just curious, it is an engaging way to learn and enjoy these classic pastimes.

channels.name: Channel Ginga
channels.description:
Channel Ginga is a specialist channel in Japan available via CS satellite and cable. It focuses on Asian dramas and culture.

Channel Ginga broadcasts dramas from across Asia, with a particular emphasis on Chinese historical and period dramas. It also features programmes on Asian history, culture and travel.

Channel Ginga is a great choice for fans of epic historical dramas and Asian culture. It offers immersive storytelling for viewers who love long, sweeping series.

channels.name: Space Shower TV
channels.description:
Space Shower TV is one of Japan's leading music channels, launched in 1989. It is available via CS satellite and cable and has long been an important platform for the Japanese music scene.

Space Shower TV features music videos, artist interviews, live performances and music news, with a strong focus on Japanese artists across genres such as J-pop, rock and hip-hop. It also covers music festivals and events.

Space Shower TV is ideal for music fans who want to keep up with Japanese artists and discover new sounds. It is a great channel to have on in the background or to explore new favourites.

channels.name: Music Japan TV
channels.description:
Music Japan TV is a specialist music channel in Japan, available via CS satellite and cable. It focuses on traditional Japanese popular music, especially enka and kayokyoku.

Music Japan TV features enka and kayokyoku performances, music videos, concerts and artist programmes. It also offers singing-related content and programmes introducing both veteran singers and newer voices in the genre.

Music Japan TV is perfect for fans of enka and classic Japanese songs. It is a warm and nostalgic channel to enjoy heartfelt music and memorable performances.

channels.name: Kayo Pops
channels.description:
Kayo Pops is a music channel in Japan available via CS satellite and cable. It is dedicated to Japanese kayokyoku and pop music.

Kayo Pops features performances, music programmes and artist specials covering Japanese pop and kayokyoku from various eras. It includes both classic hits that many viewers grew up with and more recent music.

Kayo Pops is a great channel for anyone who loves Japanese songs and nostalgic melodies. It is easy to enjoy whether you want to sing along or simply relax.

channels.name: MTV
channels.description:
MTV Japan is the Japanese version of the famous international music and entertainment brand. It is available via satellite and cable in Japan.

MTV Japan features music videos, artist programmes and music news covering both Japanese and international artists. It also carries live performances, award shows and entertainment content.

MTV is perfect for music fans who want to follow both Japanese and global hits. It is a fun channel for discovering new music and enjoying performances from popular artists.

channels.name: LaLa TV
channels.description:
LaLa TV is an entertainment channel in Japan aimed primarily at women, available via CS satellite and cable. It focuses on dramas and lifestyle content.

LaLa TV features Asian and international dramas, along with lifestyle programmes covering beauty, fashion, food and wellbeing. It also offers entertainment and variety content.

LaLa TV is a good choice for viewers who enjoy romantic dramas and lifestyle inspiration. It is a relaxing channel for unwinding after a busy day.

channels.name: Takarazuka Sky Stage
channels.description:
Takarazuka Sky Stage is the dedicated channel of the Takarazuka Revue, the famous all-female musical theatre company based in Hyogo Prefecture. It is available via CS satellite and cable in Japan.

The channel broadcasts Takarazuka Revue stage performances, along with behind-the-scenes content, interviews and programmes featuring the company's performers. It gives fans a close look at the glamorous world of Takarazuka.

Takarazuka Sky Stage is a must for Takarazuka fans and anyone who loves musical theatre. It is a dazzling way to enjoy spectacular stage productions from home.

channels.name: Kids Station
channels.description:
Kids Station is a children's and anime channel in Japan, available via CS satellite and cable. It is aimed at kids and families as well as anime fans of all ages.

Kids Station features anime series for children and older viewers, along with family-friendly entertainment. Its line-up includes both popular recent titles and classic favourites.

Kids Station is a great choice for families and anime lovers alike. It is an easy channel to put on for fun, colourful entertainment.

channels.name: Cartoon Network
channels.description:
Cartoon Network Japan is the Japanese version of the well-known international animation channel. It is available via satellite and cable in Japan.

Cartoon Network features animated series for children and families, including popular international cartoons presented in Japanese. Its programmes span comedy, adventure and action.

Cartoon Network is ideal for kids and anyone who loves cartoons. It is a cheerful channel for enjoying entertaining animation from around the world.

channels.name: National Geographic Japan
channels.description:
National Geographic Japan is the Japanese version of the internationally renowned National Geographic channel. It is available via satellite and cable in Japan.

National Geographic features documentaries on nature, wildlife, science, history, exploration and world cultures. Its programmes are known for stunning visuals and engaging storytelling.

National Geographic Japan is perfect for curious minds and documentary lovers. It is a fascinating way to explore the planet and learn something new every day.

channels.name: Disney Junior
channels.description:
Disney Junior Japan is the Japanese version of Disney's channel for young children. It is available via satellite and cable in Japan.

Disney Junior features animated series for preschoolers and young children, including beloved Disney characters. Its programmes focus on fun, learning and gentle storytelling.

Disney Junior is a lovely choice for young children and their families. It is a friendly channel for cheerful, age-appropriate entertainment.

channels.name: Discovery Channel
channels.description:
Discovery Channel Japan is the Japanese version of the well-known international factual entertainment channel. It is available via satellite and cable in Japan.

Discovery Channel features documentaries and factual programmes on science, technology, engineering, adventure, survival and more. Many programmes are presented in Japanese for local viewers.

Discovery Channel is great for anyone who loves learning through engaging documentaries. It is ideal for curious viewers who enjoy science and adventure.

channels.name: Animal Planet
channels.description:
Animal Planet Japan is the Japanese version of the international channel dedicated to animals. It is available via satellite and cable in Japan.

Animal Planet features programmes about wildlife, pets, veterinary care and nature. It offers both educational documentaries and heartwarming animal stories.

Animal Planet is perfect for animal lovers of all ages. It is a delightful channel to enjoy with the whole family.

channels.name: History
channels.description:
History Japan is the Japanese version of the international History channel. It is available via satellite and cable in Japan.

History features documentaries on world history, ancient civilisations, wars, mysteries and historical figures. It also includes programmes on culture, invention and discovery.

History is ideal for history buffs and anyone who enjoys learning about the past. It offers fascinating stories and insights into how the world came to be.

channels.name: TBS News
channels.description:
TBS News is the TBS group's dedicated 24-hour news channel, available via CS satellite and cable in Japan and connected to the TBS NEWS DIG news brand. It draws on the reporting resources of TBS and the JNN news network.

TBS News provides continuous coverage of domestic and international news, including politics, economics, society and weather. It also features breaking news, press conferences and in-depth news programmes.

TBS News is a dependable channel for staying informed about what is happening in Japan and around the world. It is ideal for viewers who want to check the news whenever it suits them.
